name: Betrayer's Inclinations delivers Betrayer's Blow against Demons only (#13005)
contract: Betrayer's Inclinations 804758 (Felsworn) tooltips: while active, your attacks against Demons have a $h%
(10%) chance to deliver Betrayer's Blow, dealing ${$804766m1+$AP*.25+$SP*.5} Physical damage and stunning
the target for $804766d (2 sec). Its Effect2 is PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 804766 with ProcChance 10, but Spell.dbc
has no ProcFlags and there is no spell_proc row, so #13005 reports that the blow never happens. Betrayer's
Blow 804766 itself names 'a Demon' but has no TargetCreatureType. Expected: melee auto attacks and melee
abilities proc the blow at 10% against Demons only; it deals 25 to 26 base damage plus 25% of attack power
and 50% of spell power, and applies its stun. The felsworn swings at a Felguard (6115, Demon) until the
first blow, which is near certain within 120 swings (0.9^120 is about 3e-6). The control swings at a wolf
(299, Beast) for 120 seconds, about 60 swings, and must never deliver it (without the Demon restriction at
least one blow would follow with about 99.8% probability). Armor reduces the Physical hit, so the damage
floor is 15% of the felsworn's attack power, which the base damage alone cannot reach.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Activate Betrayer's Inclinations on the control
SETUP: Betrayer's Inclinations is active on the control
#13005: an attack against a Demon delivers Betrayer's Blow
SETUP: the damage check sees at most two blows
#13005: the blow adds attack power and spell power to its base damage
Keep the control swinging at the Beast for about 60 swings
SETUP: the control kept attacking the Beast
#13005: attacks against a non-Demon never deliver Betrayer's Blow
#13005: the non-Demon is never stunned by it
